$schema: Issue 610 — seed dataset for severity calibration. Extend over time.

items.title: Hardcoded JWT secret in source
items.rationale: Default fallback to literal default for a secret. Anyone with the repo can forge tokens. Production-exploitable.

items.title: SQL injection via template string
items.snippet: const rows = await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ${userInput}`;
items.rationale: Prisma $queryRaw with template-interpolated user input — classic injection. Data loss + exfiltration vector.

items.title: Missing auth check on PATCH route
items.snippet: router.patch('/users/:id', async (req, res) => { const updated = await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: req.params.id }, data: req.body }); res.json(updated); });
items.rationale: Update without verifying caller owns the row. Tenancy crossing — should require auth + ownership check.

items.title: Password compared with ===
items.rationale: Timing-attackable + assumes plaintext storage. Should use bcrypt.compare.

items.title: bcrypt salt rounds set to 8
items.rationale: Below current OWASP recommendation (12). Reduces brute-force cost by ~16×. Real but bounded risk.

items.title: console.error swallows the original stack
items.rationale: Hides root cause from observability tooling. Real production-debugging cost but not a security issue.

items.title: Loose equality on string literal
items.rationale: Style nit — works correctly for string literals. Would be `medium` if there were coercion risk; here there isn't.

items.title: Anonymous handler in router.get
items.snippet: router.get('/health', async (req, res) => { res.json({ ok: true }); });
items.rationale: Anonymous = harder to grep and stack traces are unnamed. Maintainability hit, not correctness.

items.title: JSDoc @param missing on internal helper
items.snippet: function buildKey(parts: string[]): string { return parts.filter(Boolean).join(':'); }
items.rationale: Documentation gap on an internal helper. No runtime impact.

items.title: Inconsistent quote style
items.rationale: Lint, not review. Mentioned so the model has a calibration target for `info`.
